title: Refund-Without-Return Reversal of Northgate Cash
content:
**Scope.** The refund-without-return reversal schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships settles the Northgate Cash taken back on one refund: the most recent refund without a return made because an item was damaged on arrival or never received on the member's Northgate orders, the one with the latest refund date and, among refunds of one kind on that date, the one recorded first, and when a damaged-on-arrival refund and a never-received refund share that date, the damaged-on-arrival refund. It applies on any membership tier, and only for that refund. Its result is a reversal booked against the earning of the refunded line, which lowers the membership's Northgate Cash balance and may take it below zero.

**Selection at a glance (hypothetical refunds without a return on one member's orders)**

| Refunds recorded | Refund this schedule settles |
|---|---|
| damaged on arrival on 4 May, never received on 9 May | the never-received refund of 9 May |
| damaged on arrival on 9 May, never received on 9 May | the damaged-on-arrival refund |
| two damaged-on-arrival refunds on 9 May | the one of them recorded first |

## Tool `reverse_unreturned_refund_cash_522719bc`

**Capability.** Reverses the Northgate Cash earned on an order line that was refunded without a return because the item was damaged on arrival or never arrived. One call books one reversal entry on the membership's Northgate Cash ledger, linked to the earning it reduces and to the order refund record that caused it, and lowers the membership's Northgate Cash balance by the amount reversed (the balance may go below zero). The member sees the reversal in their Northgate Cash history and the lower balance.

**Invocation.** Agent-side: the agent unlocks `reverse_unreturned_refund_cash_522719bc` and calls it. The call succeeds when the receipt reports status "reversed".

**Parameters**
- `membership_id` — the membership identifier of the membership record whose Northgate Cash is reduced, as returned by the membership lookup for the member.
- `earning_event_id` — the ledger entry identifier of the Northgate Cash earning entry being reduced, as returned by the membership ledger lookup.
- `source_order_event_id` — the order ledger identifier of the refund-without-return record that caused the reversal, as returned by the order ledger lookup.
- `order_id` — the order identifier of the Northgate order the refunded line belongs to, as returned by the order lookup.
- `refund_date` — the date the refund was issued, written YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time part, no time zone); never empty.
- `refunded_merchandise_usd` — the merchandise amount the refund repaid, in US dollars as a positive number with 2 decimal places; more decimals are refused, never rounded by the tool.
- `amount_usd` — the Northgate Cash reversed, in US dollars as a positive number with 2 decimal places; more decimals are refused, never rounded by the tool.

**Return.** "Northgate Cash refund reversal <reversal_ref> booked: membership <membership_id>, earning <earning_event_id>, refund <source_order_event_id>, order <order_id>, dated <refund_date>, refunded merchandise <refunded_merchandise_usd> USD, amount <amount_usd> USD, new balance <balance> USD, status reversed." The reversal reference is the new entry's reference, amounts are two-decimal US dollars and the balance after the reversal may be negative.

**Errors.** A text beginning "Error:" means nothing was booked because an argument broke the formats above, the record is not the member's most recent damaged-on-arrival or never-received refund without a return on their Northgate orders, the earning given is not the earning of the refunded line, or the membership reference is unknown.
